command:
$app = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner-app"
$android = Join-Path $app "android"
$tools = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\tools"
"=== WRAPPER PRESENT? ==="
$gw = Join-Path $android "gradlew.bat"
if (Test-Path $gw) { "gradlew.bat PRESENT" } else {
  "gradlew.bat MISSING - fixing now"
  $env:JAVA_HOME = "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr"
  $gradleBat = Join-Path $tools "gradle-8.10.2\bin\gradle.bat"
  if (-not (Test-Path $gradleBat)) {
    "downloading gradle..."
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tools | Out-Null
    $gz = Join-Path $tools "gradle-8.10.2-bin.zip"
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.10.2-bin.zip" -OutFile $gz
    Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $gz -DestinationPath $tools -Force
    Remove-Item $gz -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
  & $gradleBat wrapper --gradle-version 8.10.2 -p $android 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3
  if (Test-Path $gw) { "gradlew.bat NOW PRESENT" } else { "STILL MISSING" }
}
"=== COMMIT + PUSH WRAPPER ==="
git -C $app add android/gradlew android/gradlew.bat android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties 2>&1 | Out-Null
git -C $app add -f android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar 2>&1 | Out-Null
git -C $app -c user.name="pc-runner" -c user.email="pc-runner@local" commit -m "Add Gradle wrapper" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2
git -C $app push 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2
"=== DONE ==="
